data.source_chain: Quickenden & Xu 1996 (DOIs 10.1149/1.1836624 verified) via Braun 2019 Table I; used by all NIST S-NDR models

data.inside_via: Menk 2019 FLUENT: stacked counter-rotating vortices in upper 1/3; nearly stationary lower 2/3 -> diffusion-dominated fill front

data.source: standard Levich; invoked by Avdeef 2022 and by Braun (delta ~ omega^-0.5)

data.statement: 2x increase in rotation (100->400 rpm) halves delta and doubles suppressing-additive flux; breakdown potential rotation-independent, REPASSIVATION strongly rotation-dependent (Josell 2018 Fig 4)

notes: GAP: no published Sh-Re-Sc correlation for a MAGNETIC STIR BAR was found (searched Crossref/web 2026-10-28, multiple phrasings). Best available practice: use delta ~ rpm^-0.5 anchored to RDE values (25 um @ 100 rpm) with team-specific proportionality constant from P2 limiting-current test; magnetic-stirrer proportionality is geometry-specific and irreproducible unless bar/position fixed (KB Cherepanova 2025 note). Ferricyanide limiting-current calibration references exist (Scott & Lobato 2002, Chem. Educator 7:214, doi 10.1007/s00897020579a [AB, not read]) but no stir-bar-specific correlation retrieved.
